policy: Bun is the preferred package-script runner. Direct Node invocations remain compatibility exceptions until the owning slice proves a Bun or Python replacement with equivalent behavior.

exceptions.path: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node tools/generate-version.js && node tools/copy-static.js
exceptions.reason: Build behavior is part of the baseline and should be converted only after the TypeScript migration has a measured before/after build verification path.
exceptions.removalCondition: Replace with Bun/Vite-compatible invocations after build:verify matches this baseline and stays within the 5% regression budget.

exceptions.reason: Static repository and distribution checks are existing JavaScript tools. They remain on Node while migration gates are established.
exceptions.removalCondition: Convert individual checks to Bun-compatible TypeScript or Python when their owning migration issue touches the check surface and parity tests pass.

exceptions.command: test, test:unit, test:integration, test:runtime, test:services, test:tools
exceptions.reason: The test suite currently uses the Node test runner as its public test interface. Changing the runner is outside the first baseline slice.
exceptions.removalCondition: Replace or wrap with Bun's test runner only after all existing test globs pass with the same setup behavior and failure reporting.

exceptions.reason: Coverage collection is tied to c8 and Node test execution.
exceptions.removalCondition: Replace after Bun coverage or another approved coverage path enforces the same thresholds through check:coverage-thresholds.

exceptions.reason: Score refresh still uses JavaScript while scraper-adjacent refresh behavior is evaluated for a separate Python migration.
exceptions.removalCondition: Replace selectively with Python or typed Bun-compatible tools when golden fixtures and parity checks prove equivalent output.

exceptions.reason: Developer automation remains JavaScript until the core migration gates are in place.
exceptions.removalCondition: Convert after CI/local documentation and migration baseline checks no longer depend on direct Node execution.
